title: Ridgeline Installation Services Walkthrough, Punch-List and Sign-Off Periods
content:
At the end of a Ridgeline Installation Services job the program terms decide whether a final walkthrough is held, the punch-list holdback percentage and punch-list resolution period, and how many days pass before an unsigned completion certificate is treated as signed.

| Program | Final walkthrough required before closing | Punch-list holdback (percent of the contract price) | Punch-list resolution period (calendar days after completion) | Completion sign-off treated as given after (calendar days after completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | no | 0 | 0 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | no | 0 | 0 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | yes | 0 | 0 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | yes | 10 | 14 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | yes | 10 | 14 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | yes | 0 | 0 | 7 |

## Reading the table

- The punch-list holdback percentage is the program's percentage of the contract price that relates to punch-list items recorded at the walkthrough; only the kitchen cabinet and countertop and bath remodel programs have one (10 percent), with a punch-list resolution period of 14 calendar days after completion.
- The carpet and hard surface flooring programs hold no final walkthrough; their completion sign-off is treated as given 3 calendar days after completion when the certificate is unsigned.

## Program questions answered

**After how many days is an unsigned bath remodel completion certificate treated as signed?** After 7 calendar days from the completion date.

**Does a window and door job carry a punch-list holdback?** No; the program holds a final walkthrough but its holdback percentage is 0.
